comment: ANCHOR: SINCE_CLOSE_POSITION_DEDUPE_LQ1387_20261108 — the 2026-11-08 23:06 ET Home card printed $760 moved on
a Visa position that had moved $380, $218 for a $109 PFE move and $483 for a $243 ANET move, and doubled the
item's exposure with it. _title_key folds 'Story' and 'Story - Yahoo Finance' into ONE item on purpose, and
build_feed appended a holdings entry per news row, so two feed copies of one story appended the same position
twice and rank_feed summed both. A name in two accounts is still one move (build_moves carries
holdings_context.market_value_total), so a second entry for a symbol is a copy, never a second account.
One position per symbol at construction (_add_holding) and, defensively, where the dollars are summed.
Synthetic fixtures; no DB, no network, no live file.
